==Treasure Trails==
===Medium===
* '''Baraek:''' I must ask you something...
* {{tact|receives=a challenge scroll}}
* {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (medium) detail.png|Baraek has given you a challenge scroll!}}
* {{tact|end}}

====When talked to again====
* '''Dunstan:''' Please enter the answer to the question.
* {{tcond|When given the wrong answer:}}
** '''Baraek:''' Wrong! Try again.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|When given the correct answer:}}
** '''Baraek:''' Correct.
** {{tcond|When given another clue scroll:}}
*** {{tact|receives=another [[Clue scroll (medium)|clue scroll]]}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (medium) detail.png|Baraek has given you another clue scroll!}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|When given a reward casket:}}
*** {{tact|receives=a [[Reward casket (medium)|medium reward casket]]}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Reward casket (medium) detail.png|You've obtained a casket!}}
*** {{tact|end}}
